title: The Grothendieck homotopy hypothesis

result.label: The Grothendieck homotopy hypothesis
result.statement: Proves the Grothendieck homotopy hypothesis for ∞-groupoids associated with every Grothendieck coherator in the Ara–Henry convention: these algebraic objects recover the homotopy theory of spaces.
